description: Android MVP touch controls in the deployment phase. Real InputEventScreenTouch/ScreenDrag events (TouchInputAdapter.inject_*) travel the DisplayServer -> root window_input path a finger uses: tap a unit row in the deploy list, tap the board to place it (lands under the finger), pinch to zoom, two-finger pan, tap the on-screen Fit button, Android back -> Esc.

steps.script:
TouchInputAdapter.set_enabled(true)
return TouchInputAdapter.enabled and not Input.emulate_mouse_from_touch

var tp = tree.current_scene.deployment_controller.temp_positions
return tp.size() == 1 and tp[0] != null and tp[0].distance_to(Vector2(1066.0, 2213.0)) < 3.0

var m = tree.current_scene
TouchInputAdapter.set_meta('z0', m.view_zoom)
var c = Vector2(930, 560)
TouchInputAdapter.inject_touch(0, c + Vector2(-60, 0), true)
TouchInputAdapter.inject_touch(1, c + Vector2(60, 0), true)
for k in range(1, 11):
	TouchInputAdapter.inject_drag(0, c + Vector2(-60 - 8 * k, 0))
	TouchInputAdapter.inject_drag(1, c + Vector2(60 + 8 * k, 0))
return true

var m = tree.current_scene
TouchInputAdapter.set_meta('o0', m.view_offset)
for k in range(1, 11):
	TouchInputAdapter.inject_drag(0, Vector2(850 + 6 * k, 560 + 4 * k))
	TouchInputAdapter.inject_drag(1, Vector2(1010 + 6 * k, 560 + 4 * k))
TouchInputAdapter.inject_touch(0, Vector2(910, 600), false)
TouchInputAdapter.inject_touch(1, Vector2(1070, 600), false)
return true

var d = tree.current_scene.view_offset - TouchInputAdapter.get_meta('o0')
return d.length() > 20.0 and TouchInputAdapter.state == 0
